"''We cannot get past their cannon, sir.|Whorm Loathsom, and the captain|}} A [[B1-series battle droid]] served as a '''captain''' in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|CIS]] [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. The [[battle droid]] served within the [[Whorm Loathsom's army|army]] of [[General]] [[Whorm Loathsom]] and participated in the [[Battle of Christophsis]]. When a number of the [[army]]'s [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tanks]] were destroyed and prevented the others from moving forward, General Loathsom asked the [[captain]] why the [[tank]]s stopped. The captain then informed General Loathsom that it was a result of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[AV-7 Anti-vehicle Artillery Cannon]]s. {{Droid-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The battle droid captain first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] film, and was identified as a captain in the film's descriptive audio. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} {{Hologram}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Separatist officers]]
